name: Changzhou Tronly New Electronic Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Changzhou Tronly New Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of electronic special materials and plastic products in China and internationally. It offers photoinitiators, resins and monomers for PCB photoresist, LCD photoresist, and semiconductor photoresist; raw materials for UV-curing coatings, inks, adhesives, 3D-printing and other special chemicals, such as photoinitiators, photocurable resins, monomers, sensitizers, additives, and intermediates; and materials for advanced packaging, including electroplating and PSPI. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
